comparison.objective: PR-2164 function-tests a seat-belt retractor by slow payout, jerk locking, sustained pull, and controlled rewind; the candidate adjusts and function-tests a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2164 tests acceleration-sensitive webbing manipulation, tension maintenance, and controlled retraction; the candidate tests two-tool threaded adjustment and countertorque followed by lever actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2164 requires ordered payout, lock within 25 mm, sustained load, gentle return, release, and dwell; the candidate requires a locked 90° stop with bounded drift across three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both include functional cycling, but the seat-belt task tests inertial-lock behavior and tension control, not setting and retaining an adjustable mechanical stop.
